text:
Priya: Morning 11 Exec wants a narrowed proposal on observability cuts by EOD. We have three asks from customers: (1) route-level cost breakdown, (2) better tracing for cold-starts, (3) error analytics with quick grouping. Need a recommended MVP + stretch.

Sam: Proposal MVP = route cost + simple error aggregation. Route cost: ingest model id + tokens per request, join to route tag. Daily rollups to reduce storage. UI: stacked bar of cost by route + filter. Effort ≈ infra 1.5 sprint, frontend 1 sprint.

Luis: Tracing cold-starts is expensive to store. Alternative: emit a lightweight "cold_start" span event in runtime and tag existing sampled traces with that flag. That gives signal without full-span retention. Perf: near-zero on happy path, small cost on cold paths.

Jenna: CS pushed hard on "error drilldowns". Customers want to see sample requests causing top errors and ability to export top-10 failing prompts. Privacy/legal flagged this as risky. Suggest MVP = aggregated error buckets + ability to link to sanitized request id (no raw prompt).

Priya: Ranking criteria (how exec will decide): customer impact, engineering cost, risk (privacy/perf), and go-to-market urgency. Weighting: impact 40%, cost 30%, risk 20%, urgency 10%.

Sam: Using that, scorecard: per-route cost (impact high, cost medium, risk low) => green. Error aggregation (impact high, cost low, risk medium) => green. Full request samples & repro prompts (impact medium, cost high, risk high) => cut from MVP. Tracing hooks for cache/KV misses (impact medium, cost high) => staged.

Luis: Rollout plan suggestion:
- Week A: backend ingestion + rollup job behind feature flag; UI skeleton. Canary 2% traffic.
- Week B: expand to 20% if no perf regressions; enable sampled trace link.
- Week C: 100% and turn on daily rollups.
Add an emergency off switch and alert on inference node CPU > 70%.

Jenna: Pilot note: SigmaHealth & NoteWave want repro prompts, but both agreed to a sanitized approach if we can show ROI. I'll negotiate pilot scope.

Priya: Launch criteria draft:
- Per-route cost visible in console and exported CSV
- Traces: sampled traces with cold_start flag and link from request detail; sampling <= 5%
- Errors: aggregated buckets + top-20 error types with counts and links to sanitized example ids
- No customer-facing repro prompt feature in MVP

Sam: Implementation details: new kafka topic "obs.events.v1" with message schema {request_id, route, model_id, tokens, error_code, cold_start_flag}. Daily rollups run in Spark -> materialized view for UI.

Luis: Sampling settings we should try in canary: `trace.sample_pct = 2.0` and `trace.retention_days = 7` for hosted. Dedicated can have longer retention.

Priya: Risk log: privacy on request samples (legal), storage cost for traces (>3x current), perf regression during canary if trace serialization blocks I/O. Mitigations: sanitize on ingest, retention caps, async fire-and-forget emit with backpressure safeguards.

ops-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/obs-mvp-1764 - please add design/infra owners.

Jenna: I'll produce a 3-question survey for pilots by noon and collect responses by EOD.

Sam: If exec wants cuts: cut trace retention to 3 days and remove CSV export (low value) to save infra runway.

Priya: Final call: propose MVP = per-route cost + aggregated error buckets + sampled traces with cold_start flag (sampling <=5%), no repro prompts. Present to exec at 3pm. Any objections?

Luis: No objections. Want perf-run results before broad rollout.

Jenna: No objections from CS.

Sam: No objections from Eng.

Priya: Great 11 I'll update the roadmap doc and exec slides.
